joc_complexity.rule: parse the same validated EMDF; require ID14 downmix_index=3, channel_count=5, object_count=15 and ID11 slot_count=16; emit object_count+1
joc_complexity.clock: codec source call consuming the assembled EMDF; source s writes the field into AU s-2 when s>=2

payload_timeline.producer_readiness_rule: all four bodies must exist before the first queue mutation
payload_timeline.publication_gate: source 0 and 1 do not publish; source s>=2 publishes AU s-2 after all four push/pop operations
payload_timeline.upstream_producer_execution_order: NOT_ESTABLISHED; JOC/OAMD/ID2 are precomputed model inputs, while ID1 timer update is executed in this timeline function
